name: multi-model-review
description: Review code or a draft with other AI models (Claude CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Google Gemini CLI, Codex or the Anthropic API), run locally and read-only, with the managing agent checking every claim. Also an orchestrator: hands plan tasks to other models, each in its own git worktree, and commits each task with the agent that did it.

interface.shortDescription: Other models review your work or carry out plan tasks, and every result is checked
defaultPrompt: Run the multi-model review on this branch.
